settings.name: Hide unpaid content
settings.description: Hides content you do not have access for due to missing payment

settings.name: Playlists
settings.description: Settings for creator collections shown as playlists.

settings.name: Load extra playlist info
settings.description: Send extra (batched) requests when listing a creator's playlists to show accurate item counts and hide empty (non-media) collections. May slow down loading.

settings.name: Playlist sort order
settings.description: Order of items inside a collection/playlist.

settings.name: Advanced
settings.description: Settings not intended for most users, but may help with troubleshooting.

settings.name: Request Retries
settings.description: Retry failed HTTP requests (rate-limit and server errors) up to 3 times before failing.

settings.name: Verbose notifications
settings.description: Show toast notifications for plugin trace messages and failed requests (useful for debugging).
